subject: Carnatic Music (Melodic Instruments)

source.title: Carnatic Music (Melodic Instruments), Code 032, Classes XI-XII (2026-27)

internalBreakdown.component: Internal assessment: project file 5, project work 5, periodic practical tests 10

notes: Theory 30 marks (2 hours) without a unit-wise split; practical 50 (external examiner); internal assessment 20.

units.name: Theory: History and Theory of Indian Music

chapters.name: Musicians and Composers (Class XI)
topics: Veena Dhanammal, Rajamanikkam Pillai, Tirukkodikaval Krishna Iyer, Tyagaraja, Syama Sastri, Muthuswami Dikshitar

chapters.name: Musical Forms (Class XI)
topics: Geetam and its varieties; varnam; swarajati; kriti/kirtana

chapters.name: Terms (Class XI)
topics: Nada, sruti, swara, vadi, vivadi, samvadi, anuvadi, amsa, nyasa, jaati, raga, tala, jati, yati, suladi sapta talas, nadai, arohana, avarohana

chapters.name: Ragas, Varnam Notation and Talas (Class XI)
topics: Adi, Roopaka, Misra and Khanda chapu; suladi sapta talas

chapters.name: Ragas and Compositions (Class XI)
topics: Mayamalavagowla, Sankarabharanam, Kharaharapriya, Kalyani, Madhyamavati, Arabhi, Pantuvarali, Kedaragaula, Vasanta, Kanada

chapters.name: Varnams, Alapana and Gamakas (Class XI)
topics: Two Adi tala varnams in two speeds
